segments.text:
V. 4.
The chief Prieſts—That is, not only the High-prieſt and his Deputy, with thoſe who formerly had borne that Office; but alſo the chief Man in each of thoſe twenty-four Courſes, into which the Body of Prieſts were divided, 1 Chron. xxiv. 10. The ſ•ribes were thoſe whoſe peculiar Buſineſs it was, to explain the Scriptures to the People. They were the public Preachers, or Expounders of the Law of Moſes: Whence the chief of them were called Doctors of the Law.
